BaseScreenDataContract.Name: Run Query
BaseScreenDataContract.QueryText:
SELECT mg.NAME, m.PropertyName, md.Description, * FROM Boa.cor.Messaging m JOIN Boa.cor.MessagingGroup mg ON mg.MessagingGroupId = m.MessagingGroupId JOIN Boa.cor.MessagingDetail md ON md.Code = m.Code AND md.LanguageId = 1 WHERE md.Description LIKE '%İşlemin durumu valör gü%' OR m.PropertyName = 'LetterInformation'
EXEC TRE.sel_TxnFXByKey @TxnNo='1'
SELECT TxnFlags, * FROM TRE.TxnFX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TxnNo = 1
